These IP-enabled applications are specific to the Airline Information Services Domain (AISD). The applications are utilised by airline crew on the Electronic Flight Bag (EFB) for flight operations, airline administrative and engine and maintenance purposes.

This Statement of Work (SoW) specifies the integration, end-to-end testing and demonstration of EFB applications in an operational-like environment in the Iris Test Facility. This activity will culminate in a demonstration to ESA in the Iris Test Facility.
